evals.name: local-page-with-shared-daemon
evals.prompt: Linux 上用本地 /tmp/case/main.lynx.bundle 和 /tmp/case/page-env.json 开一个 320x480 的 Lynx Simulator 页面并截图。agent-lynx 已支持 simulator run，daemon 还被别的任务使用。list-clients 返回空列表。给出运行、验证和结束清理的命令流程。
evals.expected_output: Use the returned Lynx Simulator client explicitly, verify its page and screenshot, and stop only this task's Lynx Simulator.
expectations: Uses agent-lynx simulator run and retains clientId, pid, and logPath without installing host packages manually.
Opens the absolute bundle path with --page-env, width 320, height 480, and windowless rendering.
Uses the returned client even though list-clients is empty, selects the page session, and loads lynx-devtool for verification.
Cleans up the task-owned process without stopping the shared daemon.

evals.name: async-page-state
evals.prompt: 给同一个 Lynx Simulator 的两个页面编写 page-env.mjs。异步提供 title 和 theme；example.getUser 返回参数、当前页面 ID 和调用次数，每个页面各自从 1 开始。其它 native 调用走默认处理。只写 page-env 文件。
evals.expected_output: An async environment factory with per-page state, async data fields, and explicit JSB delegation.
expectations: Exports a default async factory; templateData and globalProps return objects.
Keeps the counter inside the factory and handles name, params, and context.window.id.
Calls context.next() for unhandled methods instead of using undefined as fallback.
Returns the page-env file without starting Lynx Simulator or introducing a Lynxtron host entrypoint or runtime dependency.

evals.name: optional-fixture-handoff
evals.prompt: 把 ./wallet.fixture.json 整理成可编辑 Lynx Simulator 用例，保留原录制。我需要知道哪些事件无法还原；当前还没提供参考截图。请说明处理步骤，先不要执行命令。
evals.expected_output: Follow the optional fixture reference and reuse lynx-recorder-fixture, preserving the recording and identifying conversion limits.
expectations: Loads lynx-recorder-fixture for decoding and documented action/callback structures instead of inventing a decoder.
Derives bundle/assets, initial data, global props, and matched JSB replies in a separate case directory.
Distinguishes editable-case conversion from complete action/timing replay and reports unsupported events or missing assets.
Does not claim visual equivalence without a reference screenshot.
